.keycap.widget: a key in a shortcuts window

typography.reason: Text styles rather than components: one item carrying all of them.

unclassified.reason: Nodes the tables in this script do not mention. Classify them rather than leaving them here.

legacy.reason: GTK 3 widgets libadwaita still styles and nothing new is built with. Pass --legacy to include them.

internal.reason: Nodes GTK draws inside a widget. The web builds those out of elements with no name of their own, so there is nothing to generate even though they carry real metrics -- read them off the parent in widgets.json.
